Privacy policy

Last updated: 11 November 2026

What SiteWhiteboard stores

Your boards, your language choice and, if you have Pro, your licence key are stored in your browser's local storage on your device. SiteWhiteboard has no user accounts and does not upload your boards to a server.

Advertising

We show ads from Google AdSense on our pages. Google and its partners use cookies to show ads based on your visits to this site and other sites. You can turn off personalised ads in Google's Ads Settings (adssettings.google.com), and read how Google uses data at policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.

Payments

Pro is sold through a third-party payment provider. That provider handles your payment details; we never see your card number. When you activate Pro, your licence key is sent to the provider to check that it is valid.

Server logs

Our hosting provider may record technical data such as your IP address and browser type for security and to keep the site running.

Contact

For any privacy question, write to us at contact@sitewhiteboard.com.
